# an empty-handed-like use with a non-block item lights the ore, a second use leaves it lit
B 3 -60 2 minecraft:redstone_ore[lit=true]
I Alice 0 minecraft:iron_pickaxe*1
B 3 -60 2 minecraft:redstone_ore[lit=true]
# a placeable block item: the ore lights and the stone is placed against the clicked face
B 5 -60 2 minecraft:deepslate_redstone_ore[lit=true]
B 5 -59 2 minecraft:stone
I Alice 0 minecraft:stone*7
# the cell in front is occupied: the block item cannot be placed so the use succeeds without placing
B 5 -60 2 minecraft:deepslate_redstone_ore[lit=true]
B 5 -59 2 minecraft:stone
I Alice 0 minecraft:stone*7
# a side face click places next to the ore
B 7 -60 2 minecraft:redstone_ore[lit=true]
B 8 -60 2 minecraft:stone
I Alice 0 minecraft:stone*6
# random ticks turn lit ores off again
B 3 -60 2 minecraft:redstone_ore[lit=false]
B 5 -60 2 minecraft:deepslate_redstone_ore[lit=false]
B 7 -60 2 minecraft:redstone_ore[lit=false]
# attack lights the ore when the dig starts but too few ticks leave it standing
DIG Alice ticks=1 broken=false
B 3 -60 3 minecraft:redstone_ore[lit=true]
